csv_scope_of_work: The State of Connecticut, Department of Transportation may be seeking a consultant to provide the Construction Engineering & Inspection for Project 83-273. This project proposes to mill and pave the Milford Parkway, as well as lengthen acceleration and deceleration lanes by revising the lane arrangements with new pavement markings at the interchange with 1-95 and Route 1. This includes the addition of a dedicated exit lane from Milford Parkway South onto 1-95 North Exit 2A.The Roadside Safety Hardware will be Replaced and brought up to Current Stds.Bridge No 01445 Carrying Milford Parkway over East Rutland Road is Planned to beRehabilitated to address damage to one of the Griders.
